scientific_integrity.priority_limits: The recent source identifies and enumerates the three rules; an older source gives reversibility of the conjugating map. An indexed and primary-literature comparison did not reveal the two-class theorem, but publication priority remains unverified independently.
scientific_integrity.proof_type: Local Boolean identities and explicit inverse, plus exhaustive 32-state spatial-period-five functional-graph enumeration.
scientific_integrity.theorem_scope: Exactly two classes among the three specified binary five-site representatives, under shift-commuting topological conjugacy. Reversible conjugacy of A and B; periodic-orbit obstruction for C.
scientific_integrity.unproved_limits: No proof that any of the three maps is LEO or non-LEO; classification does not cover ordinary conjugacy lacking shift commutation or other elementary-equivalence representatives.
scientific_integrity.verified_checks: 32 five-bit cases, 128 seven-bit inverse cases, 1..8 periodic ring comparisons, 32-state graphs of A, B, C at spatial period five.

title: Two shift-commuting conjugacy classes among three unresolved binary two-to-one cellular automata
